commit_message:
[Build] Stop CMake riscv64 defaults from clobbering test cpu-features (#24866)

platform cmake defaults were appending
--iree-llvmcpu-target-cpu-features= after test variants, so the default
overwrote +xsmtvdot / VLEN. this prevents the override of an existing
cpu-features flag; prepend missing +m,+a,+f,+d,+c. and strips those from
generator --requirements=.

Towards: #24859

---------

Signed-off-by: Terence <terrencemahlatini@gmail.com>

commit_message:
Implemented iree_hal_command_buffer_flush_buffer as a NOP in every HAL driver

Now a command_buffer.flush_buffer is exported by the HAL so that the
VM can call this funciton and tests can succed once again.

Add a CTS flush_buffer_test run in direct and indirect modes on all
drivers, and cover recording/replay in the replay execute test.

Signed-off-by: Diego Bellani <bellanidiego@gmail.com>
